description: Multi-label (overlapping facet) softavg in PostgreSQL: complete IMDb genre memberships as a bridge table; GROUP BY over the join (naive / max-shift / clamp / softavg, single vs multi label) and incremental maintenance over the join (softavg_ivm_create_join, fan-out per base-row edit) vs pg_ivm, REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW and recompute-on-read.

extension.name: bruce_pg
extension.build_cmd: cargo pgrx install --release --pg-config <server>/bin/pg_config (pgrx 0.18.1; profile.release opt-level=3, lto=fat, codegen-units=1)

server.pg_version: PostgreSQL 17.10 on x86_64-pc-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Ubuntu 11.4.0-1ubuntu1~22.04) 11.4.0, 64-bit

server_build_per_arm.pgrx_tests: pgrx-managed cassert server (correctness only, no timings)

protocol.timing: 1 warm-up + 3 timed runs, client wall, median; EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, TIMING OFF) for plan shape
protocol.reference: numpy float64 max-shifted per group over the multiset the join produces
protocol.queries: first 3 PROTOCOL queries, precomputed score columns s0..s2
